gate: Gate-D step 2 (map-match candidates), candidate generation only
supervisor_note: docs/evaluation/supervisor_contract_decision_form.md is unsigned; no supervisor approval is claimed or implied

inputs.network: accepted Greater Manchester baseline (ADR-059/060), 804,611 real road edges

outcomes.note: every one of the 305 observations reached exactly one terminal disposition; none disappeared from reconciliation

invariant_cross_checks.note: policy 1.0 disables automatic final acceptance, so even a clear_candidate awaits analyst confirmation

road_identity.dft_placeholder_handling: DfT records a category placeholder rather than a road number for unnumbered minor roads: 125 of 305 sites carry 'U' and 19 carry 'C'. These are treated as absent references, not compared as road numbers, so a placeholder never appears to disagree with every candidate edge.
road_identity.motorway_standard_a_road: A57(M) occurs in the real data and is recognised as a signed reference

rejection_ledger.note: every retrieved-then-rejected edge keeps its reason; nothing is discarded silently

policy_gap_found.summary: seven road classes present in the real network are in neither the approved admit lists nor the approved exclude list
policy_gap_found.handling: fail closed, but reported under a distinct reason 'not_in_approved_policy' rather than folded into 'hard_excluded'
policy_gap_found.reason: both outcomes reject the candidate, but only one of them represents a decision the owner actually made. Reporting them together would describe the policy as more complete than it is.
policy_gap_found.owner_action_available: extend the approved class lists to cover these, or confirm that failing closed is intended

substantive_finding_for_the_owner.summary: the Major/Minor class split rejects some edges that are plausibly the correct road
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.detail: 21 sites terminate as no_suitable_candidate. 12 are DfT Major and 9 Minor. Several sit on the A56 (5 sites) and A6042 (4 sites) with a rejected edge less than one metre away - the nearest rejected edge for one A56 site is 0.880 m. The dominant rejection reasons across these sites are hard_excluded (9 sites), wrong_road_type_family (6), not_in_approved_policy (3), and outside_eligibility_for_geometry_source (3).
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.interpretation: DfT's road_type and OpenStreetMap's highway class are independent classifications. Where OSM tags a stretch of a numbered A road as a minor class, the approved hard family split rejects the edge even though the road identity matches exactly. This is a policy-refinement question, not a defect in the run: the observations correctly remain unavailable rather than being attributed to a road the policy does not admit.
options_for_the_owner: allow an exact signed-reference match to override the road_type family split, subject to analyst confirmation
widen the Major admissible class set
accept that these sites stay unavailable, and record the resulting coverage loss
substantive_finding_for_the_owner.not_decided_here: no option above has been chosen or implemented; the approved policy was applied exactly as authorised

explicit_non_claims: candidate generation is not acceptance; no match has been accepted
no analyst review has been performed
confidence is triage and is not a probability or a scientific confidence interval
no demand, calibration, comparison, or simulation was produced by this run
